title: The edge multiset dimension of hypercubes
summary: For a graph G and a nonempty set S of vertices, the edge multiset representation of an edge e is the multiset of distances from e to the elements of S, where d(uv,s)=min{d(u,s),d(v,s)}. The edge multiset dimension edim_m(G) is the minimum cardinality of a set whose edge representations are pairwise distinct, and is infinite if no such set exists. A recent survey asked whether edim_m(Q_d) is infinite for every d >= 3.
